creator: Alexander Terp
description:
GitHub issue #1 part 2 (amterp, 2026-10-07): a Codex pane on a devenv stopped reading its input after its turn ended - 2817 unread bytes in its pty, unchanged - and the app raised "Input reached the pane ... painted nothing since ... the bridge ... has wedged", offering only Reattach. Bridge and daemon were healthy. The same freeze made `msg post` print `woke: <group> (idle)` and `muster window` show the pane idle, so a director waited for an answer that could not come.

The issue's suggestion: read the pty's input queue before blaming the bridge; unread input that stays put means the program is not reading. Then the notice, `msg post` and `window` can each say so.
title: ⏸️ A program that stopped reading its input reads as idle, and the bridge gets the blame
